integrity: The proof separates the published rank-four existence theorem and published rank-at-most-three obstruction from the new direct-sum propagation argument. No computational or independent-validation claim is made.
scientific limitations: The rank threshold is exact, but the stated ambient-dimension bound is only a sufficient construction bound; no optimality in dimension, center, or radius is asserted.
title: Rank four is the exact rank threshold for off-center circular numerical ranges
